item.title: Why this year’s Valentine’s Day could be the most expensive love story yet
item.description: Americans will spend a record $29.1B this Valentine’s Day — and some of that love (and cash) is going to friends, co-workers and even pets.

item.title: Chicken wings are cheaper, but other Super Bowl snacks cost more this year
item.description: Americans are expected to eat nearly 1.5 billion chicken wings during the Super Bowl, about 10 million more than last year, according to the National Chicken Council.

item.title: Yum Brands to shutter hundreds of Pizza Hut stores amid strategic review
item.description: Pizza Hut will close 250 underperforming U.S. stores as parent Yum Brands conducts a strategic review; U.S. sales fell 5% in 2025 amid global declines.

item.title: Company pulls candy in 20 states from shelves after packaging error
item.description: More than 6,000 bags of peanut and classic M&M’s sold in 20 states are recalled after packaging failed to list milk, soy and peanut allergens.

item.title: Survey: 87% of Americans say US faces a cost-of-living crisis
item.description: A nationwide survey finds 87% of Americans believe the nation is in a cost-of-living crisis, with half struggling to pay bills or afford everyday necessities.

item.title: Tax refunds could be bigger this year — here's how to get more money back
item.description: Changes to the standard deduction, child tax credits, deductions for seniors, and no tax on tips could give taxpayers a boost, and mean a bigger refund in your wallet.

item.title: These school-safe cupcakes are free of top 9 allergens
item.description: Looking for a cupcake that’s safe to share at school and loved by kids? These cupcakes are free from all nine of the top food allergens.

item.title: Many US workers have under $1,000 saved for retirement, new report finds
item.description: Many working Americans remain unprepared for retirement, according to a new report from the National Institute on Retirement Security.

item.title: Lyft launches teen ride-sharing service in select cities with enhanced safety features
item.description: Lyft is rolling out a new ride-sharing option specifically designed for teenagers, called "Lyft Teen."

item.title: New analysis shows Trump's tariffs cost US households an average of $1,000 last year
item.description: President Donald Trump's tariff policies cost each American household an average of $1,000 last year, and are set to cost those households an average of $1,300 through 2026, according to new analysis.
